purpose: Implement a read-only, independently sourced action-consequence transfer and cold-retention intake boundary; do not originate, generate, score or first-use actual independent scientific data in this engineering gate.

hypothesis.transfer: The P78-MR fixed three-parameter learned factual memory will generalize to independently witnessed new action-consequence environments, under same 256-float memory, no refit, no query/lookahead, against strongest properly calibrated and fully-trained conventional controls.
hypothesis.null: The P78-MR authored synthetic advantage does not survive novel external causal sources, cold retention, regime changes, strong controls or whole-process compute.
hypothesis.criteria_reserved_for_separate_science: No SCIENTIFIC_PASS threshold may be applied in this engineering gate; independent source admission, exact-source qualification, owner first-use, matched fully trained controls and preregistered external holdout required before science.

source_contract.no_self_attested_independence: source_kind and provenance metadata are DATA, not proof; external source remains UNVERIFIED until owner-controlled witness and admission
source_contract.unit: native 16-float unit-normalized executed action vector; realized 16-float finite effect vector, no posthoc learned projection or scale adjustment
source_contract.event_seq: positive increasing contiguous event_id in each world; chronological actual execution
source_contract.probe_semantics: Probe action actually executed after its given factual event prefix; actual measured effect provided as evaluator target only, never used to update memory. For multi-probe challenge, each independent probe is evaluated at its declared historical prefix; do not implicitly write probe effect.
source_contract.source_checksum: SHA256 of canonical sorted-key compact JSON serialization of worlds; compare to caller-pinned manifest expected_sha256; immutable world/probe IDs and receipt refs, reject nonfinite, zero and malformed vectors, duplicate IDs, missing receipts, nonmonotonic boundaries
source_contract.input_gate: Pure schema/digest validation is allowed without scoring; EXTERNAL_SIMULATOR/PHYSICAL forward prediction and any metrics require separate project-owner first-use permission, not granted by this protocol.
source_contract.test_scope: Only small in-memory TOY_ENGINEERING fixtures; no external source, no paid API, no live actuation; no re-use of P69/P75/P76/P77/P78-MR original synthetic data.

frozen_comparators.learned: p78mr selected non_directional3 static theta for exact model seeds 978201/978203/978207; source is Git blob c180bfa8dab735000360ba2e87f51dbe42ec3d89; do not tune theta or use external fit/cal.
frozen_comparators.fixed: p78mr CAL-selected fixed rule eta=0.4; no external recalibration.
frozen_comparators.other_conventional: Trained GRU/SSM and domain-appropriate controls required for any external superiority claim; unavailable control explicitly disqualifies independent acceptance.
frozen_comparators.capacity: Exactly 16x16=256 persistent float state per world, static weights separately disclosed, no hidden episode cursor/role/time/adaptation state, no external raw history replay beyond evaluation harness.

engineering_acceptance: Exact parent blobs checked and model theta loaded only from frozen P78-MR receipt.
Source digest and split/world-id disjointness pass, malformed/no provenance/nonfinite vectors fail closed.
Only factual executed action/effect passed to memory writer; changing all probe effects, group labels, receipt refs or future events cannot alter prior predictions.
Every probe score is read-only, no update from target; explicit prefix cut and action query only.
Tensor-only cold state restored at arbitrary prefix reproduces continuous encoding bit-for-bit and same predictions.
Model predictions on synthetic toy do not constitute scientific performance data; external source predictions and scoring forbidden absent owner admission.
Exact-blob local focused tests plus mandatory full final-SHA original Windows and Linux regression/build separately; GitHub zero-step CI is infrastructure failure, not a passing test.
All new code/results/checkpoints/evidence stored in repo paths; no Library files, attachments or downloadable archive.

scoring_plan_after_owner_first_use.state_outcome: final and time-indexed probe effect MSE stratified changed vs stable
scoring_plan_after_owner_first_use.retention: cold restoration, interference loss, unchanged-role retention at long delays
scoring_plan_after_owner_first_use.adaptation: changed causal relationship recovery conditional on observed corrective action count
scoring_plan_after_owner_first_use.uncertainty: paired world-level bootstrap across independently witnessed source cohorts
scoring_plan_after_owner_first_use.compute: train+calibration+transfer full wall/FLOPs/peak memory; no equal-compute inference from equal state capacity
scoring_plan_after_owner_first_use.decision: Separate future preregistration and qualified admission; no testing of author-generated toy data as independent evidence.
